title: Rory and the Lantern Tree Glade
verses:
The stars started blinking above in the sky,
As Rory walked softly through mosses so deep.
A cozy cool breeze gave a velvety sigh,
And promised the forest it soon was for sleep.

Sweet Nia soared down through the silver-lit shade,
While Psittaco chirped from his snug cozy nest.
Big Benny marched slow through the sweet-scented glade,
To join gentle Rory for bedtime and rest.

Wild Ricky slowed down as he rested his feet,
And Tilly brought leaves that were fragrant and dry.
They gathered around where the pine branches meet,
To watch the soft lanterns of bugs drifting by.

Young Rory laid moss on the cozy green floor,
To make a soft cushion so plush and so warm.
The night gently settled and closed up its door,
To keep all the dino-friends safe from the storm.

The moon cast a glow on each weary green head,
As Psittaco snuggled near Nia’s soft wing.
Big Benny yawned slow as he stretched in his bed,
Content with the lullaby night-crickets sing.

Then Rory breathed out as he closed both his eyes,
And cuddled up close to his friends in the dark.
Beneath the calm glow of the starry-lit skies,
Sleep landed as soft as a flickering spark.

title: Rory and the Silver Moss Valley
verses:
The moon had arisen above the dark trees,
When Psittaco chirped from a moss-covered nest.
High up in the air flew sweet Nia with ease,
To lead all her friends to a valley of rest.

The moss was as soft as a pillow of green,
Beside a clear stream where the water rolled slow.
Sweet Tilly stepped down with a smile so serene,
As Benny sank deep in the shadows below.

Sturdy Ricky stretched out on a carpet of blue,
And rested his chin on his heavy front paw.
Tiny Psittaco snuggled in leaves wet with dew,
With feelings of comfort and magical awe.

Big Rory curled up with a sleepy green tail,
He yawned at the stars as they started to gleam.
A soft silvery light drifted down on the vale,
To carry the friends on a whispering dream.

The night-crickets sang in a quiet refrain,
While Nia tucked wings on a warm rocky ledge.
No shadow or worry was left to remain,
Safe out on the quiet and velvety edge.

So hush now, sweet child, while the silver stars keep
Their watch on the world in a magical glow.
For now it is time to fall softly asleep,
Where peaceful and beautiful dream-rivers flow.

title: The Secret of the Whispering Falls
verses:
The sun dipped away behind ridges of blue,
When Nia swooped low with a chirp of delight.
She led all her friends through the shimmering dew,
To find where the waterfall glowed in the night.

Behind the cool spray was a wide, hidden shelf,
Where giant soft ferns caught the mist in the air.
Each dinosaur found a dry spot for itself,
Content with the magical calm waiting there.

Psittaco gathered dry leaves in a heap,
And made a small cushion right next to the wall.
His chirps turned to whispers, preparing for sleep,
Entranced by the soothing cascade of the fall.

Then Ricky and Benny worked side by side now,
To roll a large boulder to block out the chill.
With teamwork complete and a yawn from the brow,
They felt all the bustle of daytime go still.

Sweet Tilly leaned close to the thunder-soft sound,
Her heavy tail resting along the damp stone.
A blanket of tranquility settled around,
Ensuring that nobody rested alone.

Green Rory sank down with a satisfied sigh,
His mighty green tail curled up close to his chest.
With moon-shadows drifting across the dark sky,
The friends closed their eyes and surrendered to rest.
